Paalala: The reading can be wrong. Compare every time with the scan before you confirm. This only works for the current 25-row form. There is no automatic billing and no update to Google Sheets or BSRS.
1

Choose the blank form and the scans

Use a blank form and scans that have the same names and layout.

FILE A · ORIGINAL FORM

Choose the original PDF from your Google Sheet. The names are taken from it. One page only.

FILE B · NASULATANG FORM

You can choose many PDF, JPG or PNG files, or one PDF with many pages. One batch or roster only, and the same 25-row form. Up to 366 pages, 150 MB per scan file and 750 MB in total.

Choose File A and File B, enter the details, then press “Open the batch”.
First time? Read the short guide
  1. Choose the blank PDF with names and the matching filled-in scan. Enter the batch, date and reviewer.
  2. Press “Open the batch”, then “Read all pending pages”. One upload is enough for many days. After that, open each page and check the date and green lines.
  3. If it is crooked, press “Crooked? Click the 4 corners”. Click the top left, top right, bottom right and bottom left of the 25 scholar rows. Do not include the headers.
  4. Tick the alignment box. If the page was not read yet, press “Read the times”.
  5. Compare every time with the picture. Fix the time and AM/PM, and write a review note. If you cannot read it, do not confirm it.
  6. Only confirm entries you have checked. Download the reviewed CSV as a separate review file. Google Sheets is not updated automatically.

Lunch 12:00–13:00 is deducted only where it overlaps the interval. A daily preview is capped at 8 hours as requested; this is a configurable design assumption, not a verified TESDA payment rule. Course totals and BSRS reconciliation are NOT included. If other non-training breaks occur, this one-interval prototype is not sufficient: do not approve that row for payment.

Download JSON to retain the review evidence; this version cannot reopen that JSON as a session. Reloading closes your current work. Keep the original scan with the export. Signature images are shown for human review only; their authenticity is not assessed.

Batch upload: many days in one upload

One training batch and the same roster only. The reader does not guess the date from the handwriting. Enter the right date for each page before you confirm.

Click Read all. Then check each page. Download your results before you close. The session is not saved automatically.
Quickly fill in suggested dates (optional)

Only use this if the pages are in date order with one page per training day. Holidays and suspensions are not detected, so still check every date.

The date in Step 1 is for the current page. Compare it with the date printed on the scan. Big batches can take a while, so keep this tab open.

2

Line up the form

Each green line should sit on one scholar row.

The green box should cover the 25 scholar rows only. The blue strips are on Time In and Time Out. Do not include the header or the signature below the table.

See the names and their order

One name per line. Fix the order here before you read the times.

3

Check, confirm and download

Compare with the picture → fix the time and AM/PM → add a note → confirm.

Only confirmed rows are in the CSV. Nothing in the live Google Sheet is changed. Download before you close. The session is not saved automatically, and the review JSON cannot be loaded back into the reader yet.
+

Collect handwriting samples

OPTIONAL. This is to improve the reader later. You do not need it to export the attendance.

On a confirmed row, open Save corrected digits for training. Pick the label and tick each clear digit, then Save. Only digit images and labels are included. No name, signature or full attendance page is saved. Check the crops before you save.

This only collects samples. The reader does not retrain or get better right away when you correct something. A new model still has to be trained and tested on separate scans. The number of saved samples is not the model accuracy.
Continue from downloaded samples

Import an earlier training JSON to add to the next session. It is separate from the attendance review JSON. Nothing is uploaded automatically and nothing is kept in browser storage.

About, Credits & Licenses

Developed for
TESDA Zambales Provincial Office

Development release v0.9.3. Human review is required. This attribution does not constitute official TESDA approval or validation for billing.

Prototype limits: small handwritten-digit neural network trained on MNIST, not a TESDA-validated OCR model. Model scores are not calibrated probabilities of correctness. Overwriting, borders touching digits, different layouts, perspective distortion and poor scans can cause errors. All suggested entries require review. Processing and model run locally; all libraries and weights are bundled. No analytics, remote calls, automatic storage or API charges.
Built with a local JavaScript inference engine and Mozilla PDF.js 3.11.174 (Apache-2.0). Training uses the MNIST dataset. This is an experimental alternative to the earlier proposed TensorFlow.js setup; no software installation is needed beyond a desktop browser.
Technical notes & licenses

Inference: 784→128→64→10 multilayer perceptron, ReLU / softmax. Independent MNIST holdout accuracy is recorded in the model metadata; it is not an accuracy claim for these attendance scans. Raw suggestions remain separate from corrected values. No attendance scan was used to train the model. Automatic geometry uses line projections with a four-corner manual fallback. Model is deliberately not allowed to change a digit merely to make a valid time.
